hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean card UI and smooth animated layout transitions show technical polish, but the pack view is cropped at the bottom of the viewport, Tableau10 colors are generic rather than curated, and there is no typographic hierarchy or labeling within the visualization itself.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Structurally honest: scaleSqrt used correctly for area encoding in both force-layout node radii and sunburst radial bands, key functions present in data joins (d => d.data.id), all layout domains data-driven, no zero-baseline violations (no bar/area charts), no dual-axis risk, and bundle paths pre-filtered so no silent-gap issue — minor deductions for synthetic random connections and a few hardcoded canvas-size constants.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Force simulation tick drives three un-throttled full DOM-join passes (drawNodes + drawBundles + drawHierLinks) plus a redundant updateHighlight call on every tick frame; all other patterns are sound — RAF coalescing on the bundling slider, interruptAll() before layout transitions, pointer events avoiding mouse-touch double-fire, and no cross-view feedback loops.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: Pack layout is readable — 7 well-separated Tableau colors, nested containment makes hierarchy clear, and 300 bundle paths at 0.15 opacity form ambient texture rather than spaghetti; animation fidelity and force-layout density can't be fully assessed from the static screenshot.
